dev:
Entries are evicted on access if they exceed the TTL, and the
oldest entry is evicted on insert when the size cap is exceeded.
TTL of zero disables expiry; a max_size of zero disables the cache.
Not thread-safe; intended for asyncio single-loop use.
notice: LRU cache with hard size cap and per-entry TTL eviction.

pattern.name: cache
pattern.rationale: Bounded TTL cache for upstream payloads.
pattern.violations: Unbounded dict caches leak memory and serve stale data.

summary: LRU cache with hard size cap and per-entry TTL eviction.
